text_block_list.name: VR Umulator
text_block_list.text: "Please enter settings."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Set the scenario to the day of the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe. Please reflect last 
year's data for the participating 
Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Due to the previous day's rain, the track 
condition turned terrible. ...Conditions 
that I struggle with.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The outfit is... ...For now, I'll stick 
with my usual racing silks.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone has gained more experience 
compared to where they were last year.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yet I have been training hard too. I've 
become stronger.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: So even under these conditions—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaaahhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh... Aaaah...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Why... ngh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A training day with <chrname>. Unfortunately, 
yesterday's heavy rain took its toll, 
leaving the track in terrible condition.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, it is no obstacle for her after 
all the training she's done. I send her 
off as she is.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...Even on track conditions like this, 
you really can shine, can't you?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...I have a request for the two of you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Would you please clash with me with 
everything you've got in the next 
Representative Exchange Race?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: And that is why I wish to settle this.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...To this passion that surges up every 
time I look at you all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond squeezes out her words. 
Sensing her sheer resolve, <chrname> and I nodded 
in agreement.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...I must do this.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: —For my sake.
